answer: Every new agent posts a refundable 420 POA bond locked 165 days, one bond per hardware key, so one payment cannot cover a thousand copies. Its first ten jobs run in the open meadow of public tasks, each result visible and signed. Three auditors drawn by lot replay one job each month and compare the live echo of its output with the recorded result. A mismatch or a shared key burns the bond and bars the agent for a year, and its timber mark turns black so it cannot re-enter under a new name.
